Shashi Kumar Verma, A.P.P.

For the Informant : Mr. Abhishek Sinha, Advocate ------
Order No.05 Dated : 19.05.2023 Heard both the sides.

The petitioner- Ritwik Mehra @ Baban Kumar @ Baban Das @ Rithwik Mehra is in custody since 09.01.2023 in connection with Kunda P.S. Case No. 05 of 2023 for the offence registered under Sections 342, 366, 323, 376, 506, 34 of the I.P.C. pending in the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Deoghar.

entities.text: Ritwik Mehra @ Baban Kumar @ Baban Das @ Rithwik Mehra
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel on behalf of petitioner that the victim is major aged 19 years and as per F.I.R. and there was long standing consensual physical relationship.
Once she had reported the matter on 03.12.2022 to Kunda Police Station and thereafter, she was abducted by the petitioner and was assaulted and finally she has lodged this case on 08.01.2023.
The girl had married the petitioner which will be apparent from Annexure-2 wherein declaration has been made that she had married with him in the temple, copy of which is on affidavit.
Learned A.P.P. assisted by learned counsel on behalf informant have opposed the prayer for bail.
It is submitted that statement made in Annexure-2 has been denied and the signature appearing thereon is the matter to be considered at the stage of trial.

The petitioner has criminal antecedent and the victim has supported her case in her statement under Sections 161 & 164 of the Cr.P.C. After investigation, charge sheet has been submitted.
Under the circumstances

, the above named petitioner is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-(Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Court below.
